boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named campus spaces with documented academic, recreation, practice, or cadet-life uses.

cards.title: ABS Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Library and IT help on the first floor
cards.notes: Start a research session here, then use the first-floor Service Desk for library questions, equipment checkout, or technology assistance.
cards.short_summary: A single campus stop for research support, borrowing, and IT help.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library/IT Service Desk is on the first floor of the ABS Information Commons and assists students with research and technology needs.
cards.access_notes: ABSIC building hours listed by the Academy are 0600–2300 daily; library and IT desk hours vary.

cards.title: Clean Harbors Pool
cards.subtitle: Olympic-sized campus pool
cards.notes: Check Academy recreation information before planning a swim; the pool is used for cadet recreation and athletics aquatics rehabilitation.
cards.short_summary: An Olympic-sized pool documented as a cadet recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says its Olympic-sized pool is routinely used by cadets, faculty, and staff for recreational purposes.
cards.access_notes: The Academy states that the pool is not open to the public.

cards.title: Free Weight Room
cards.subtitle: Clean Harbors Athletics Center
cards.notes: Use this designated strength-training space when eligible, and follow facility guidance for the power racks, free weights, and selectorized equipment.
cards.short_summary: A campus weight-training area with several equipment zones.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy describes weight rooms in the Clean Harbors Athletics Center with power-rack, free-weight, and selectorized rooms.
cards.access_notes: The Academy says the weight rooms are open to cadets, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Alumni Gym
cards.subtitle: Volleyball, practices, and recreation
cards.notes: Look for a game or recreation window in this gym, which also includes a second-level cardiovascular area around the court.
cards.short_summary: A gym used for volleyball, team practices, events, and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says Alumni Gym hosts women's volleyball, other teams' practices, campus events, and routine recreational use.
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to Academy facility access and scheduled team or event activity.

cards.title: The Pier at T.S. Patriot State
cards.subtitle: Small-boat and shipboard training area
cards.notes: View the waterfront training setting from authorized areas; cadets use small boats here for sea-service and engineering watchstanding experience.
cards.short_summary: A documented waterfront site for practical cadet training.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy identifies the pier as a place where cadets use small boats for sea-service and engineering watchstanding experience.
cards.access_notes: Observe all waterfront controls and access restrictions; training operations may be active.

cards.title: Hendy Field
cards.subtitle: Buccaneer baseball and cadet activities
cards.notes: Check the athletics calendar or watch from permitted spectator areas when baseball, Regiment activities, or intramurals are scheduled.
cards.short_summary: The Academy's longstanding baseball field also used for cadet activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy calls Hendy Field the longtime home of Buccaneer baseball and says the Regiment uses it for activities and intramurals.
cards.access_notes: Field availability depends on athletic, intramural, and Academy activity schedules.

cards.title: Parade Field
cards.subtitle: Weekday morning formation site
cards.notes: Watch morning formation from an authorized public vantage point, keeping clear of the cadet muster and any active ship operations nearby.
cards.short_summary: A field tied to the Academy's weekday morning formation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says cadets muster on the Parade Field Monday through Friday at 0720 to salute the American flag.
cards.access_notes: Formation occurs Monday through Friday at 0720, according to the Academy; maintain appropriate distance.

cards.title: Admiral's Hall
cards.subtitle: Large lectures and cadet events
cards.notes: Look for an announced lecture, speaker, meeting, or concert in this large hall rather than assuming general access between events.
cards.short_summary: A large event hall used for cadet-facing programs and concerts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says Admiral's Hall hosts larger events, public speakers, meetings with cadets, and annual 7th Company Band and Honor Guard concerts.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled classes, events, and Academy authorization.

cards.title: Kurz IMB Center
cards.subtitle: Maritime-business research and speakers
cards.notes: Follow the Academy calendar for a speaker series or related program, and use the space's shipping and maritime-business focus as context.
cards.short_summary: A campus center connecting cadet education with maritime-business research.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says the Kurz IMB Center supports cadet education on global shipping and maritime business challenges, including a speaker series.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled classes, programs, and Academy authorization.

cards.title: Flanagan Lecture Hall
cards.subtitle: Lecture classes and meetings
cards.notes: Use the Academy schedule to identify an open academic event; this hall is documented for lecture-style classes and some meetings.
cards.short_summary: A named lecture venue supporting classes and campus meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says Flanagan Lecture Hall is used primarily for lecture-style classes and some meetings.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled classes, meetings, and Academy authorization.
